description: This file defines the Exponential class which contains a method to compute the exponential distribution (both probability density function and cumulative distribution function) used in statistical calculations within PHPSpreadsheet's Calculation library.

classes.name: Exponential
classes.description: A class providing a method to compute exponential distribution values, including probability density and cumulative distribution functions.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Calculates the exponential distribution's probability density or cumulative distribution value based on the input parameters, handling array inputs and validation.
